title: Settlement Authority Matrix for Settlement Agreements by Placement Stage
content:
# Settlement Agreements — Settlement Authority Matrix

Each programme of Ridgeline's Settlement Agreements carries two settlement percentages for every placement stage of a Placed Consumer Account: the **authority floor**, the lowest settlement percentage Ridgeline may offer on its own authority at that stage, and the **approval floor**, the lowest settlement percentage that may be offered at that stage even with client approval. A settlement percentage is the share of the balance at offer that the settlement amount represents.

## Authority floor (percent of the balance at offer)

| Placement stage | Prompt-Pay Discount Settlement | Lump-Sum Settlement | Two-Payment Settlement | Three-Payment Settlement | Six-Payment Settlement | Hardship Settlement |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Early-Out Placement | 90.0 | 100.0 | 100.0 | 100.0 | 100.0 | 100.0 |
| Primary Placement | 100.0 | 70.0 | 75.0 | 78.0 | 82.0 | 55.0 |
| Secondary Placement | 100.0 | 55.0 | 60.0 | 63.0 | 67.0 | 40.0 |
| Tertiary Placement | 100.0 | 45.0 | 50.0 | 53.0 | 57.0 | 30.0 |
| Warehouse Placement | 100.0 | 35.0 | 40.0 | 43.0 | 47.0 | 25.0 |
| Legal Review Placement | 100.0 | 75.0 | 80.0 | 83.0 | 100.0 | 60.0 |

An authority floor of 100.0 at the Early-Out Placement or the Legal Review Placement stage means the programme is not offered at that stage.

## Approval floor (percent of the balance at offer)

| Placement stage | Prompt-Pay Discount Settlement | Lump-Sum Settlement | Two-Payment Settlement | Three-Payment Settlement | Six-Payment Settlement | Hardship Settlement |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Early-Out Placement | 90.0 | 100.0 | 100.0 | 100.0 | 100.0 | 100.0 |
| Primary Placement | 100.0 | 50.0 | 55.0 | 58.0 | 82.0 | 40.0 |
| Secondary Placement | 100.0 | 40.0 | 45.0 | 48.0 | 67.0 | 30.0 |
| Tertiary Placement | 100.0 | 30.0 | 35.0 | 38.0 | 57.0 | 20.0 |
| Warehouse Placement | 100.0 | 20.0 | 25.0 | 28.0 | 47.0 | 15.0 |
| Legal Review Placement | 100.0 | 60.0 | 65.0 | 68.0 | 100.0 | 45.0 |

## Reading the matrix

- The Prompt-Pay Discount Settlement is an Early-Out Placement programme: its authority floor there is 90.0 and every other stage reads 100.0.
- For the Six-Payment Settlement the authority floor and the approval floor are the same figure at every stage.
- The matrix is read by the account's current placement stage, as the placed account shows it.

## Hypothetical lookup

A hypothetical Lump-Sum Settlement on a Secondary Placement account reads an authority floor of 55.0 and an approval floor of 40.0; the same account under the Hardship Settlement reads 40.0 and 30.0.
